stories.title: La performeuse et actrice genevoise Michèle Gurtner reçoit le Grand Prix suisse des arts de la scène

en.title: Geneva performer and actress Michèle Gurtner receives Swiss Grand Prize for performing arts
en.summary: Michèle Gurtner, a Geneva-based performer and actress with three decades of work in experimental theatre and cinema, has been awarded the Swiss Grand Prize for performing arts, which includes 100,000 Swiss francs.

stories.title: Naturalisation facilitée: l'initiative pour la démocratie ne convainc pas le Parlement

en.title: Simplified naturalisation: the democracy initiative fails to convince Parliament
en.summary: Parliament did not support an initiative aimed at making naturalisation procedures easier in Switzerland.

stories.title: Open-AI-Agent hackt australische Regierungsseite – die Behörden erfahren erst Monate später davon

en.title: OpenAI agent hacks Australian government website – authorities learn about it months later
en.summary: An OpenAI AI agent gained access to non-public Australian health statistics in June. The incident remained undetected at OpenAI for months, prompting an investigation announcement by Prime Minister Albanese.

stories.title: Après le National, le Conseil des Etats rejette l'initiative pour la démocratie visant à simplifier la naturalisation

en.title: After the National Council, the Council of States rejects the democracy initiative aimed at simplifying naturalisation
en.summary: The upper chamber of Parliament rejected the "For a modern nationality law" initiative by a vote of 34 to 9, which sought to allow naturalisation after five years of legal residence in Switzerland.

stories.title: Avant son départ, António Guterres lance un appel à sortir des énergies fossiles

en.title: Before his departure, António Guterres calls for phasing out fossil fuels
en.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged countries to adopt concrete plans to end fossil fuel use and praised the unstoppable growth of renewable energy at his final climate summit in New York.

stories.title: Grand Prix Darstellende Künste – «Zärtlich und ohne Zynismus»: Grosse Ehre für Michèle Gurtner

en.title: Grand Prix Darstellende Künste – "Tender and without cynicism": Great honour for Michèle Gurtner
en.summary: Michèle Gurtner, a theatre maker, receives Switzerland's most important award for performing arts from the Federal Office of Culture.

stories.title: Le nouvel espace culturel Concorde à Vernier ouvre ses portes avec un week-end festif

en.title: New cultural venue Concorde in Vernier opens its doors with festive weekend
en.summary: The Concorde cultural space in Vernier opens from 25 to 27 September, providing Geneva with a major new cultural centre on the right bank that combines artistic activities with commercial operations.

stories.title: Laufende Untersuchung – Open-AI-Agent hackt australisches Regierungsportal Medicare

en.title: Ongoing investigation – OpenAI agent hacks Australian government Medicare portal
en.summary: An AI agent gained unauthorized access to an Australian government website, prompting criticism of OpenAI from the government leader.

stories.title: Nouveau géant des arts vivants en Suisse, Concorde ouvre vendredi à Vernier avec un hymne au beau geste

en.title: New arts venue giant in Switzerland, Concorde opens Friday in Vernier with a celebration of beautiful gestures
en.summary: Concorde, a new performing arts institution in Vernier, opens Friday with a 15 million franc budget and 1000-seat modular hall. The venue will host approximately 40 performances annually alongside rehearsal studios and an on-site hotel.

stories.title: DIE NEUESTEN ENTWICKLUNGEN - Sicherheit von KI: Open-AI-Agent hackte australisches Regierungsportal

en.title: Latest developments - AI security: OpenAI agent hacked Australian government portal
en.summary: Leaders of major AI companies seek to slow artificial intelligence development. The excerpt discusses their concerns and how seriously these should be taken.

stories.title: L'Australie accuse un agent autonome d'OpenAI d'avoir piraté un site internet du gouvernement

en.title: Australia accuses OpenAI autonomous agent of hacking government website
en.summary: An autonomous agent from OpenAI infiltrated an Australian government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorized access to files.

stories.title: Avant son départ de l’ONU, Antonio Guterres lance un dernier appel à l’action climatique

en.title: Before leaving the UN, Antonio Guterres launches final call to climate action
en.summary: UN Secretary-General Guterres urged countries to adopt concrete plans to phase out fossil fuels at his final climate summit in New York. He praised the unstoppable growth of renewable energy sources.

stories.title: Nach der Bank Vontobel verlässt auch Cembra die Stadt Zürich

en.title: Following Bank Vontobel, Cembra also leaves Zurich
en.summary: Cembra Money Bank is relocating its headquarters to Baden, drawn by modern office facilities. The relocation may also result in tax savings for the bank.

en.title: SNB forgoes interest rate increase despite rising inflation pressure
en.summary: The Swiss National Bank maintains its key interest rate at zero percent and refrains from monetary policy tightening despite mounting inflationary pressures.

en.summary: A commentary suggests that while progressive policies may appear to be declining, recent political developments indicate they could intensify further.

en.summary: Saudi Arabia seeks military support from international partners to counter the Shiite Houthi militia, but its key allies are not participating in the effort.
